question: Should ClawHub wait for a public/registry-readable OpenClaw design-system package, or grant CI/deploy/Dependabot cross-repository read credentials for this private SSH dependency?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the organization's private repository access policy or decide whether generic OpenClaw design skills belong in this repo-local skill tree.

options.title: Wait for readable package
options.body: Make the design-system package public, registry-published, or otherwise readable by hosted automation before refreshing the lockfile and merging.

options.title: Approve explicit credentials
options.body: Grant narrowly scoped cross-repository read access for CI, deploys, and Dependabot, then document the operational ownership before merge.

options.title: Split skill guidance first
options.body: Land only a narrower ClawHub-specific skill/adaptor change now and defer the runtime package dependency until the access policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Wait for readable package
recommendation.body: Make the design-system package public, registry-published, or otherwise readable by hosted automation before refreshing the lockfile and merging.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current package/repo-policy history owner visible in blame and the collaborator driving this integration branch.
